passages.text: The second lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Simeon: Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah and included Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah, Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem, Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susah, Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen—thirteen cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Simeon was one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
The people of Simeon had different clans.
The second lot was drawn for the tribe of Simeon and its clans.
Their inheritance was inside the territory of the tribe of Judah.
The inheritance of Simeon included these cities:
Beersheba (also called Sheba),
Moladah,
Hazar-shual,
Balah,
Ezem,
Eltolad,
Bethul,
Hormah,
Ziklag,
Beth-marcaboth,
Hazar-susah,
Beth-lebaoth,
and Sharuhen.
There were thirteen cities in total.
Their inheritance also included the villages around these cities.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֤ל הַשֵּׁנִי֙ לְשִׁמְע֔וֹן לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ שִׁמְע֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑ם וַֽיְהִי֙ נַֽחֲלָתָ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָֽה׃ וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם בְּנַֽחֲלָתָ֑ם בְּאֵֽר־ שֶׁ֥בַע וְשֶׁ֖בַע וּמוֹלָדָֽה׃ וַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּבָלָ֖ה וָעָֽצֶם׃ וְאֶלְתּוֹלַ֥ד וּבְת֖וּל וְחָרְמָֽה׃ וְצִֽקְלַ֥ג וּבֵית־ הַמַּרְכָּב֖וֹת וַחֲצַ֥ר סוּסָֽה׃ וּבֵ֥ית לְבָא֖וֹת וְשָֽׁרוּחֶ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan—four cities, along with their villages, and all the villages surrounding these cities as far as Baalath-beer (Ramah of the Negev). This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Simeon.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Simeon had several clans.
Their inheritance included four cities.
The cities were Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan.
These cities had villages with them.
There were also villages around these cities.
These villages reached as far as Baalath-beer.
Baalath-beer is also called Ramah of the Negev.
This land was the inheritance for the clans of Simeon.
passages.original: עַ֥יִן׀ רִמּ֖וֹן וָעֶ֣תֶר וְעָשָׁ֑ן עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּ֖ע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ וְכָל־ הַֽחֲצֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר סְבִיבוֹת֙ הֶֽעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עַד־ בַּֽעֲלַ֥ת בְּאֵ֖ר רָ֣אמַת נֶ֑גֶב זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ שִׁמְע֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the territory of Judah, because the share for Judah’s descendants was too large for them. So the Simeonites received an inheritance within Judah’s portion.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Simeon received land for their inheritance.
This land came from the territory of the tribe of Judah.
The tribe of Judah had more land than they needed.
The tribe of Simeon received their inheritance inside Judah’s territory.
passages.original: מֵחֶ֙בֶל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחֲלַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן כִּֽי־ הָיָ֞ה חֵ֤לֶק בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָה֙ רַ֣ב מֵהֶ֔ם וַיִּנְחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ שִׁמְע֖וֹן בְּת֥וֹךְ נַחֲלָתָֽם׃פ

passages.text: The third lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Zebulun: The border of their inheritance stretched as far as Sarid.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Zebulun had several clans.
The Israelites divided land among the tribes by casting lots.
The third lot was for the tribe of Zebulun.
This lot determined their inheritance.
The border of Zebulun’s inheritance reached as far as Sarid.
passages.original: וַיַּ֙עַל֙ הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לִבְנֵ֥י זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיְהִ֛י גְּב֥וּל נַחֲלָתָ֖ם עַד־ שָׂרִֽיד׃

passages.text: It went up westward to Maralah, reached Dabbesheth, and met the brook east of Jokneam.
passages.sermon:
The border of the tribe of Zebulun went westward.
It reached Maralah.
It reached Dabbesheth.
It met the brook that is east of Jokneam.
passages.original: וְעָלָ֨ה גְבוּלָ֧ם׀ לַיָּ֛מָּה וּמַרְעֲלָ֖ה וּפָגַ֣ע בְּדַבָּ֑שֶׁת וּפָגַע֙ אֶל־ הַנַּ֔חַל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י יָקְנְעָֽם׃

passages.text: From Sarid it turned eastward along the border of Chisloth-tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Zebulun received land as their inheritance.
Their border started at Sarid.
From Sarid, the border turned east.
It followed the border of Chisloth-tabor.
It went out to Daberath.
It went up to Japhia.
passages.original: וְשָׁ֣ב מִשָּׂרִ֗יד קֵ֚דְמָה מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ עַל־ גְּב֥וּל כִּסְלֹ֖ת תָּבֹ֑ר וְיָצָ֥א אֶל־ הַדָּֽבְרַ֖ת וְעָלָ֥ה יָפִֽיעַ׃

passages.text: From there it crossed eastward to Gath-hepher and to Eth-kazin; it extended to Rimmon and curved around toward Neah.
passages.sermon:
The border of the tribe of Zebulun started at a certain point.
From that point, the border went east.
It reached Gath-hepher.
It continued to Eth-kazin.
Then the border extended to Rimmon.
After Rimmon, the border curved around toward Neah.
passages.original: וּמִשָּׁ֤ם עָבַר֙ קֵ֣דְמָה מִזְרָ֔חָה גִּתָּ֥ה חֵ֖פֶר עִתָּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְיָצָ֛א רִמּ֥וֹן הַמְּתֹאָ֖ר הַנֵּעָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the border circled around the north side of Neah to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah-el.
passages.sermon: The border of the tribe of Zebulun circled around the north side of Neah.\r\nIt went to Hannathon.\r\nThe border ended at the Valley of Iphtah-el.
passages.original: וְנָסַ֤ב אֹתוֹ֙ הַגְּב֔וּל מִצְּפ֖וֹן חַנָּתֹ֑ן וְהָיוּ֙ תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֔יו גֵּ֖י יִפְתַּח־ אֵֽל׃

passages.text: It also included Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem. There were twelve cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
The inheritance of the tribe of Zebulun included several cities.
These cities were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem.
There were twelve cities in total.
These cities also had their villages.
passages.original: וְקַטָּ֤ת וְנַֽהֲלָל֙ וְשִׁמְר֔וֹן וְיִדְאֲלָ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית לָ֑חֶם עָרִ֥ים שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Zebulun, including these cities and their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Zebulun had several clans.
God gave these clans an inheritance.
This inheritance included certain cities.
It also included the villages around these cities.
passages.original: זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־ זְבוּלֻ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑ם הֶֽעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

passages.text: The fourth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Issachar: Their territory included Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem, Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath, Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez, Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Issachar was one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
The people of Issachar had different clans.
The fourth lot was chosen for the tribe of Issachar and its clans.
This lot decided their territory.
Their territory included the city of Jezreel.
It also included Chesulloth.
It included Shunem.
It included Hapharaim.
It included Shion.
It included Anaharath.
It included Rabbith.
It included Kishion.
It included Ebez.
It included Remeth.
It included En-gannim.
It included En-haddah.
It included Beth-pazzez.
passages.original: לְיִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הָֽרְבִיעִ֑י לִבְנֵ֥י יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃ וַיְהִ֖י גְּבוּלָ֑ם יִזְרְעֶ֥אלָה וְהַכְּסוּלֹ֖ת וְשׁוּנֵֽם׃ וַחֲפָרַ֥יִם וְשִׁיאֹ֖ן וַאֲנָחֲרַֽת׃ וְהָֽרַבִּ֥ית וְקִשְׁי֖וֹן וָאָֽבֶץ׃ וְרֶ֧מֶת וְעֵין־ גַּנִּ֛ים וְעֵ֥ין חַדָּ֖ה וּבֵ֥ית פַּצֵּֽץ׃

passages.text: The border reached Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
The border of the tribe of Issachar reached Tabor.
The border reached Shahazumah.
The border reached Beth-shemesh.
The border ended at the Jordan River.
There were sixteen cities in this territory.
These cities included their villages.
passages.original: וּפָגַע֩ הַגְּב֨וּל בְּתָב֤וֹר וְשַׁחֲצוּמָה וּבֵ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְהָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת גְּבוּלָ֖ם הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Issachar, including these cities and their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Issachar received land as their inheritance.
This inheritance belonged to the clans of Issachar.
The inheritance included certain cities.
The inheritance also included the villages around these cities.
passages.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

passages.text: The fifth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Asher: Their territory included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph, Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal. On the west the border touched Carmel and Shihor-libnath, then turned eastward toward Beth-dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah-el, and went north to Beth-emek and Neiel, passing Cabul on the left.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Asher had many families.
The fifth lot was for the tribe of Asher.
This lot decided their land.
Their land included Helkath.
It included Hali.
It included Beten.
It included Achshaph.
It included Allammelech.
It included Amad.
It included Mishal.
The border of their land touched Carmel on the west.
The border touched Shihor-libnath on the west.
The border turned east toward Beth-dagon.
The border touched Zebulun.
The border touched the Valley of Iphtah-el.
The border went north to Beth-emek.
The border went north to Neiel.
The border passed Cabul on the left.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַֽחֲמִישִׁ֔י לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ אָשֵׁ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃ וַיְהִ֖י גְּבוּלָ֑ם חֶלְקַ֥ת וַחֲלִ֖י וָבֶ֥טֶן וְאַכְשָֽׁף׃ וְאַֽלַמֶּ֥לֶךְ וְעַמְעָ֖ד וּמִשְׁאָ֑ל וּפָגַ֤ע בְּכַרְמֶל֙ הַיָּ֔מָּה וּבְשִׁיח֖וֹר לִבְנָֽת׃ וְשָׁ֨ב מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ֮ בֵּ֣ית דָּגֹן֒ וּפָגַ֣ע בִּ֠זְבֻלוּן וּבְגֵ֨י יִפְתַּח־ אֵ֥ל צָפ֛וֹנָה בֵּ֥ית הָעֵ֖מֶק וּנְעִיאֵ֑ל וְיָצָ֥א אֶל־ כָּב֖וּל מִשְּׂמֹֽאל׃

passages.text: It went on to Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.
passages.sermon:
The border of the tribe of Asher continued.
It included Ebron.
It included Rehob.
It included Hammon.
It included Kanah.
The border reached as far as Greater Sidon.
passages.original: וְעֶבְרֹ֥ן וּרְחֹ֖ב וְחַמּ֣וֹן וְקָנָ֑ה עַ֖ד צִיד֥וֹן רַבָּֽה׃

passages.text: The border then turned back toward Ramah as far as the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah, and came out at the Sea in the region of Achzib, Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob. There were twenty-two cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Asher received land for their families.
Their border turned back toward Ramah.
It reached the fortified city of Tyre.
The border then turned toward Hosah.
It ended at the sea, in the region of Achzib.
The territory included Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob.
There were twenty-two cities in this land.
These cities had their own villages.
passages.original: וְשָׁ֤ב הַגְּבוּל֙ הָֽרָמָ֔ה וְעַד־ עִ֖יר מִבְצַר־ צֹ֑ר וְשָׁ֤ב הַגְּבוּל֙ חֹסָ֔ה וְיִהְיוּ תֹצְאֹתָ֛יו הַיָּ֖מָּה מֵחֶ֥בֶל אַכְזִֽיבָה׃ וְעֻמָ֥ה וַאֲפֵ֖ק וּרְחֹ֑ב עָרִ֛ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁתַּ֖יִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Asher, including these cities and their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Asher received land as their inheritance.
This inheritance belonged to the families of Asher.
The inheritance included these cities.
The inheritance also included their villages.
passages.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ אָשֵׁ֖ר לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

passages.text: The sixth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Naphtali: Their border started at Heleph and the great tree of Zaanannim, passing Adami-nekeb and Jabneel as far as Lakkum and ending at the Jordan.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Naphtali was one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
The people of Naphtali had many families, called clans.
The sixth lot was chosen for the tribe of Naphtali and its clans.
This lot decided their land.
Their border began at Heleph.
It also began at the great tree of Zaanannim.
The border passed Adami-nekeb.
It passed Jabneel.
The border reached as far as Lakkum.
The border ended at the Jordan River.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֣ל הַשִּׁשִּׁ֑י לִבְנֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃ וַיְהִ֣י גְבוּלָ֗ם מֵחֵ֨לֶף מֵֽאֵל֜וֹן בְּצַעֲנַנִּ֗ים וַאֲדָמִ֥י הַנֶּ֛קֶב וְיַבְנְאֵ֖ל עַד־ לַקּ֑וּם וַיְהִ֥י תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

passages.text: Then the border turned westward to Aznoth-tabor and ran from there to Hukkok, touching Zebulun on the south side, Asher on the west, and Judah at the Jordan on the east.
passages.sermon:
The border of the land for the tribe of Naphtali turned west.
It reached Aznoth-tabor.
From Aznoth-tabor, the border went to Hukkok.
The border touched Zebulun on the south side.
The border touched Asher on the west side.
The border touched Judah at the Jordan River on the east side.
This border marked the land for the families of Naphtali.
passages.original: וְשָׁ֨ב הַגְּב֥וּל יָ֙מָּה֙ אַזְנ֣וֹת תָּב֔וֹר וְיָצָ֥א מִשָּׁ֖ם חוּקֹ֑קָה וּפָגַ֨ע בִּזְבֻל֜וּן מִנֶּ֗גֶב וּבְאָשֵׁר֙ פָּגַ֣ע מִיָּ֔ם וּבִ֣יהוּדָ֔ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרַ֥ח הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

passages.text: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth, Adamah, Ramah, Hazor, Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor, Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh. There were nineteen cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Naphtali received an inheritance.
This inheritance included fortified cities.
The cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth.
The inheritance also included Adamah, Ramah, and Hazor.
It included Kedesh, Edrei, and En-hazor.
It included Iron, Migdal-el, and Horem.
It included Beth-anath and Beth-shemesh.
There were nineteen cities in total.
These cities had their villages with them.
passages.original: וְעָרֵ֖י מִבְצָ֑ר הַצִּדִּ֣ים צֵ֔ר וְחַמַּ֖ת רַקַּ֥ת וְכִנָּֽרֶת׃ וַאֲדָמָ֥ה וְהָרָמָ֖ה וְחָצֽוֹר׃ וְקֶ֥דֶשׁ וְאֶדְרֶ֖עִי וְעֵ֥ין חָצֽוֹר׃ וְיִרְאוֹן֙ וּמִגְדַּל־ אֵ֔ל חֳרֵ֥ם וּבֵית־ עֲנָ֖ת וּבֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ עָרִ֥ים תְּשַֽׁע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Naphtali, including these cities and their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Naphtali received land as their inheritance.
This inheritance belonged to the families of Naphtali.
It included the listed cities.
It also included their villages.
passages.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

passages.text: The seventh lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Dan: The territory of their inheritance included Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir-shemesh, Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah, Elon, Timnah, Ekron, Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath, Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon, Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, including the territory across from Joppa.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Dan had several clans.
The seventh lot was assigned to these clans.
This lot determined their territory.
Their territory included the city of Zorah.
It also included Eshtaol.
It included Ir-shemesh.
It included Shaalabbin.
It included Aijalon.
It included Ithlah.
It included Elon.
It included Timnah.
It included Ekron.
It included Eltekeh.
It included Gibbethon.
It included Baalath.
It included Jehud.
It included Bene-berak.
It included Gath-rimmon.
It included Me-jarkon.
It included Rakkon.
Their territory also included the area across from Joppa.
passages.original: לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־ דָ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם יָצָ֖א הַגּוֹרָ֥ל הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃ וַיְהִ֖י גְּב֣וּל נַחֲלָתָ֑ם צָרְעָ֥ה וְאֶשְׁתָּא֖וֹל וְעִ֥יר שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃ וְשַֽׁעֲלַבִּ֥ין וְאַיָּל֖וֹן וְיִתְלָֽה׃ וְאֵיל֥וֹן וְתִמְנָ֖תָה וְעֶקְרֽוֹן׃ וְאֶלְתְּקֵ֥ה וְגִבְּת֖וֹן וּבַעֲלָֽת׃ וִיהֻ֥ד וּבְנֵֽי־ בְרַ֖ק וְגַת־ רִמּֽוֹן׃ וּמֵ֥י הַיַּרְק֖וֹן וְהָֽרַקּ֑וֹן עִֽם־ הַגְּב֖וּל מ֥וּל יָפֽוֹ׃

passages.text: (Later, when the territory of the Danites was lost to them, they went up and fought against Leshem, captured it, and put it to the sword. So they took possession of Leshem, settled there, and renamed it after their father Dan.)
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Dan lost their territory.
The people of Dan went up to fight against Leshem.
They attacked Leshem.
They captured Leshem.
They struck Leshem with the sword.
They took possession of Leshem.
They settled in Leshem.
They renamed Leshem “Dan.”
They named it after their ancestor Dan.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א גְבוּל־ בְּנֵי־ דָ֖ן מֵהֶ֑ם וַיַּעֲל֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ דָ֠ן וַיִּלָּחֲמ֨וּ עִם־ לֶ֜שֶׁם וַיִּלְכְּד֥וּ אוֹתָ֣הּ׀ וַיַּכּ֧וּ אוֹתָ֣הּ לְפִי־ חֶ֗רֶב וַיִּֽרְשׁ֤וּ אוֹתָהּ֙ וַיֵּ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔הּ וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ לְלֶ֙שֶׁם֙ דָּ֔ן כְּשֵׁ֖ם דָּ֥ן אֲבִיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Dan, including these cities and their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Dan had several clans.
These clans received an inheritance.
Their inheritance included certain cities.
Their inheritance also included the villages around these cities.
passages.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־ דָ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶֽעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

passages.text: When they had finished distributing the land into its territories, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them, as the LORD had commanded. They gave him the city of Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, as he requested. He rebuilt the city and settled in it.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites finished dividing the land into its territories.
Joshua was the son of Nun.
The Israelites gave Joshua an inheritance among them.
The LORD had commanded them to do this.
They gave Joshua the city he asked for.
This city was Timnath-serah.
Timnath-serah was in the hill country of Ephraim.
Joshua rebuilt the city.
Joshua settled in the city.
passages.original: וַיְכַלּ֥וּ לִנְחֹל־ אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ לִגְבֽוּלֹתֶ֑יהָ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל נַחֲלָ֛ה לִיהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נ֖וּן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃ עַל־ פִּ֨י יְהוָ֜ה נָ֣תְנוּ ל֗וֹ אֶת־ הָעִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔ל אֶת־ תִּמְנַת־ סֶ֖רַח בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיִּבְנֶ֥ה אֶת־ הָעִ֖יר וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families distributed by lot to the tribes of Israel at Shiloh before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing up the land.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar was a priest of Israel.
Joshua was the son of Nun.
The heads of the families led the tribes of Israel.
Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads of the families distributed inheritances.
They used lots to divide the land.
They did this at Shiloh.
They stood before the LORD.
They worked at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
They finished dividing the land among the tribes.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַנְּחָלֹ֡ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִחֲל֣וּ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֣ן׀ וִיהוֹשֻׁ֪עַ בִּן־ נ֟וּן וְרָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֣וֹת לְמַטּוֹת֩ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל׀ בְּגוֹרָ֤ל׀ בְּשִׁלֹה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַיְכַלּ֕וּ מֵֽחַלֵּ֖ק אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
